1.title: 1. Collection and Use of Personal Data
1.text: Personal data refers to information that allows a person to be identified, such as their name, email address, or postal address. One Two Smile does not collect your personal data unless you voluntarily provide it to us, for example when placing an order, and give your explicit consent to its processing. Your personal data is stored, used, and transferred only with your consent and only to the extent necessary to achieve a specific purpose. To provide services, One Two Smile may transfer your personal data to third parties, including other companies or external service providers, solely to the extent necessary to properly process your order and provide the requested services. In such cases, One Two Smile requires these parties to process personal data in accordance with the provided instructions, this Privacy Policy, and applicable Ukrainian law. One Two Smile guarantees that it does not sell or rent your personal data to third parties for commercial purposes. However, we may disclose your personal data where required by law or in response to requests from government authorities with proper legal grounds. By clicking the “Place Order” button and/or making a payment for an order, you confirm that you have read the Privacy Policy, payment, delivery, return conditions, and other rules published on the One Two Smile website and agree to them.

2.title: 2. Data Retention Period
2.text: Your personal data is stored only for the period necessary to achieve the purpose for which it was provided or in accordance with applicable legal requirements.

3.title: 3. Protection of Your Data During Ordering and Payment
3.text: When placing an order in our online store, your personal data is transmitted in encrypted form to ensure an appropriate level of security. The payment process is carried out through secure payment channels. Important: One Two Smile does not process or store your payment card details on its own servers. Payment card data is processed through the WayForPay payment service provider.

4.title: 4. Use of Local Storage
4.text: During your visit to our website, we use your browser’s Local Storage technology. This mechanism allows small amounts of data to be stored directly in your browser, including after the page is closed or the browser is restarted. We use Local Storage to make our website more convenient to use, in particular to store the contents of your shopping cart. This allows you to continue shopping from where you left off, even if you closed the page or returned to the website later. Local Storage does not contain personal data that directly identifies you. If you do not want such data to be stored in your browser, you can delete it manually in your browser settings or disable this function. Please note that doing so may limit the functionality of the shopping cart.

5.title: 5. Contact, Information Requests, Cancellation, Blocking and Deletion
5.text: You have the right at any time to request, free of charge, information about your stored data, its correction, partial or complete blocking, or deletion. No specific form is required. You may contact us by email at [one.two.smile.dentistry@gmail.com](mailto:one.two.smile.dentistry@gmail.com) or use the contact form on our website.

6.title: 6. Updates and Changes
6.text: We reserve the right to periodically change or update individual provisions of this Privacy Policy. We recommend reviewing this document regularly before visiting our website to stay informed about current changes and updates.

7.title: 7. Product Returns
7.text: Returns and exchanges of products are carried out in accordance with applicable Ukrainian law and the rules published on the One Two Smile website. For cosmetic products of proper quality, restrictions on returns and exchanges provided by applicable law may apply. Therefore, we ask you to carefully review the product description, characteristics, and composition before placing an order. If you receive a product with visible damage, a manufacturing defect, or incorrect items, please contact us within 24 hours of receiving the order by sending photos of the damaged product or packaging and a description of the situation to [one.two.smile.dentistry@gmail.com](mailto:one.two.smile.dentistry@gmail.com) or through the contact form on the website. Each such request is reviewed individually. If the issue is confirmed, we may offer a product exchange, refund, or another solution in accordance with applicable law. We also recommend checking the condition of the packaging and product when receiving the order at a Nova Poshta branch or from a courier. If any damage is found, we recommend documenting it and reporting it to the delivery service representative.

8.title: 8. Payment
8.text: Payment for orders is made through the WayForPay payment service. Depending on the payment methods available for the store, customers may be able to pay using Visa and Mastercard bank cards, the Ukrainian national payment system “Prostir”, Privat24, Apple Pay, Google Pay, as well as available installment, split-payment, and other payment methods offered by WayForPay. The current list of available payment methods is displayed directly during the ordering and payment process. Payment card details are entered on the secure WayForPay payment page and are not stored on One Two Smile servers.

9.title: 9. Delivery
9.text: Orders are delivered exclusively by Nova Poshta throughout Ukraine to locations where Nova Poshta services are available. Orders are shipped within 1–3 business days from the date the order is placed. If an order is placed on a weekend or public holiday, the shipping period starts on the next business day. The actual delivery time after the parcel is handed over to Nova Poshta depends on the selected delivery method and destination. The delivery cost is determined according to Nova Poshta’s current rates and is paid by the customer unless otherwise stated during the ordering process. The customer may choose an available delivery option offered by Nova Poshta, including delivery to a branch or parcel locker if this option is available for the particular order.

10.title: 10. Agreement to Purchase Terms
10.text: By placing an order on the One Two Smile website and/or making a payment for the order, the customer confirms that they have read and agree to the terms of purchasing products, payment and delivery conditions, product return and exchange rules, the Privacy Policy, and other rules published on the website. The customer also confirms that the contact and delivery information provided is correct and consents to its processing to the extent necessary to process, pay for, and deliver the order.
